description: This file defines the Node class implementing nested set tree operations for ORM entities, including methods for hierarchy management such as adding children, retrieving parent/children, and deleting nodes.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Implements nested set hierarchy operations for ORM entities, managing tree structure including adding, deleting, and retrieving parent/child nodes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Node with a nested set entity.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the associated nested set entity.

methods.name: getLeftValue
methods.description: Retrieves the left value of the node.

methods.name: getRightValue
methods.description: Retrieves the right value of the node.

methods.name: hasChildren
methods.description: Checks if the node has children.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Retrieves child nodes up to a specified depth.

methods.name: hasParent
methods.description: Checks if the node has a parent.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the level of the node in the hierarchy.

methods.name: insertAsLastChildOf
methods.description: Inserts the current node as the last child of a specified parent node.

methods.name: shiftRlValues
methods.description: Shifts the left and right values of nodes starting from a specified position.

methods.name: persistNode
methods.description: Persists the node with specified left and right values.

methods.name: isLeaf
methods.description: Checks if the node is a leaf (has no children).

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Checks if the node is the root.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the node and its descendants.
